text:
jamie: Heads-up — after merging the cust-hydra LoRA into main-stable I see invoice formatting regressions in the quick eval pack. Pinging @mira @sandeep :eyes:

jamie: Short summary: invoice_amount_exact_match dropped from `0.92` -> `0.85`, mean_abs_error increased ~`0.12`. More pronounced on quantized runs.

mira: Ack. Is the drift present on fp16 too or just int4/int8?

jamie: Seen on both fp16 and int4, but int4 shows larger delta (int4 ~ -8.5% EM, fp16 ~ -3%).

sandeep: Can you paste the exact command you ran for the quick pack? I want to repro locally.

jamie: Sure — running the same on my laptop and staging.
```
./eval_pack/run.sh --model models/cust-hydra-lora:merge-2026-03-20 \
  --quant int4 --evals ./packs/invoice_quick.json --out /tmp/hydra_q
```

luca: FYI I saw a similar boundary/tokenization shift with a different adapter last month — boundaries around `$` and `#` sometimes merged into adjacent token causing formatting noise.

jamie: Example (from failing cases):
- prompt: `Invoice: $1234.56`
- expected: `Invoice: $1,234.56`
- got (fp16): `Invoice:$ 1234.56`  <-- spacing broken
- got (int4): `Invoice: $1234 .56`  <-- decimal space inserted

eva: I kicked off a dedicated-run and grabbed logs. Looks like a KV-cache alignment warning right before the invoice tests start. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:05Z] kvcache: warn - key_offset mismatch (expected 128, got 120)
[2026-03-20T14:12:05Z] tokenizer: info - subtoken merge map applied
[2026-03-20T14:12:06Z] eval: start invoice_quick (len=23)
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary for `merge-2026-03-20` -> staging in 5m :rocket:

mira: Reproduced locally with your command. Holding the staging canary for now. Trying a quick patch that forces adapter-tokenizer compatibility (adapter-swap) and re-running.

sandeep: If patch doesn't land quickly, we should enable fallback routing for that customer to `redwood/llama-2.1-base` variant until regression is fixed. Safer than letting live traffic hit malformed invoices.

jamie: Agreed. I'm prepping a canary run that pins fp16 runtime + strict-tokenizer mapping for cust-hydra and will attach regression logs in ~20m.

luca: :+1: Also recommend adding a tiny edgecase set for currency/grouping/decimal placement to the smoke evals — `packs/invoice_edgecases.json`.

jamie: Doing that now. added file at `./packs/invoice_edgecases.json` and re-ran with `--evals ./packs/invoice_quick.json,./packs/invoice_edgecases.json`. Will post results.

mira: Thanks all — keeping the canary gated. If anyone finds a reproducer tensor/seed, drop it here and I'll attach to the PR for a targeted unit test. :thumbsup:

jamie: Will do. saving failing example set to `/tmp/hydra_q/failures.json` and linking in the PR when ready.
